items.title: Economic Development Committee Appointments
items.recommendation: Upon completion of applicant interviews, Council Members may nominate applicants to be appointed to the board or commission. Once all nominations are received, a vote will be taken for each nomination beginning with the first applicant nominated.

items.title: A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Beaumont for the Authorization for the Execution of the Certifications and Assurances and Authorized Agent Forms for the Low Carbon Transit Operations Program (LCTOP) for the Following Project: Free Fare Promotion, $102,000
items.recommendation: Waive the full reading and adopt by title only, “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Beaumont for the Authorization for the Execution of the Certifications and Assurances and Authorized Agent Forms for the Low Carbon Transit Operations Program (LCTOP) for the Following Project: Free Fare Program Promotion, $102,000;” Authorize the execution of the Certificates and Assurances; and Authorize the execution of the Authorized Agent Form.

items.title: Street Selection for the Annual Citywide Street Rehabilitation and Maintenance FY21/22 Capital Improvement Program Project R-08 and R-09
items.recommendation: Approve the Street Selection for the Annual Citywide Street Rehabilitation and Maintenance FY21/22 Project CIP R-08 and R-09, and Authorize the Public Works Director to Finalize the Bid Package and Solicit Bids for the Project.

items.title: Rehabilitation and Maintenance of Sundance Community Trail
items.recommendation: Provide staff direction on proceeding with the rehabilitation and maintenance of Sundance Community Trail.

items.title: Consideration of Re-Ratification of Local Emergency and Re-Authorizing the Use of Teleconferencing to Conduct Public Meetings
items.recommendation: Waive the full reading and adopt by title only, “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Beaumont Proclaiming a Local Emergency Persists, Re-Ratifying the Proclamation of a State of Emergency by Executive Order N-09-21, and Re- Authorizing Remote Teleconference Meetings of the Legislative Bodies of the City of Beaumont for the Period of April 6, 2022, through April 5, 2022, Pursuant to Provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act.” Or take no action, resulting in the discontinuation of teleconferenced meetings exemptions under Assembly Bill 361.

items.title: BEAUMONT SUCCESSOR AGENCY Resolution of the Beaumont Successor Agency: Declaring Property as Exempt Surplus Land
items.recommendation: Waive the full reading and adopt by title only, “A Resolution of the Beaumont Successor Agency Declaring Property as Exempt Surplus Land.” Adjourn the meeting of the Beaumont Successor Agency and reconvene the regular meeting of the Beaumont City Council.
